feature_rule: H1 consolidated Jun 30 cash/assets and debt components use same-statement units. Verified restricted money-fund single-row maximum is divided by total money funds from the same PDF, same period, same scope with proven currency; never sum repeated printed rows or infer complete restricted/free cash. Blank/absent debt is missing, not zero. H1 denominators never use Q3 balances.
fit_and_clock_rule: Keep original 29 training dates ending Dec 11, purge Dec 12 and evaluate 13 dates Dec 13-31. First evaluation fit cutoff Dec 11 15:00 +08:00; only t-2 visible market features and each H1 report own publication-date proxy. Means/scales/coefficients use training only; no penalty, winsorization, clipping or tuning.
forecast_rule: Keep raw negative absolute-return forecasts and count them. Company fixed-market model is a reference without added H1 features; static source facts would be absorbed by company effects.
freeze_scope: Before computing any financing-block forecasts or error metrics. Source-only missingness inspected; old base outcomes and this development period already used.
limitations: 2019 dates and retrospective Q&A-selected 123-company parent cohort were already inspected. This is development, not new blind validation; the different 126-company batch is not mixed in.
The restriction value is the maximum verified disclosed money-fund row fraction, not total restricted share; not all restrictions are disclosed or classified. Missing source rows are not zero.
Three source-reader QC reports, ten balance/QC states, one missing H1 source and generic financial-sector exclusions remain. Available restriction and maturity samples are selected and differ.
Source/PDF and adjusted-market bytes were retrieved later; unchanged original historical bytes are not certified. H1 own publication proxies are preserved independently of Q3 availability.

Q3 controls plus H1 financing facts are from different dated reports; H1 ratios use only their own H1 denominators. One-year noncurrent liabilities are not a verified exact debt maturity distribution.
Repeated financial facts/shared dates are dependent. Delete-one-date ranges are sensitivity, not confidence intervals, significance or independent replication.
This risk regression does not validate stock direction, policy causality, investor behavior, endogenous market dynamics or regulatory early warning; no Agent signal or trading cash amount is enabled.
multiple_comparison_rule: Primary restriction/cash-buffer block fixed before outputs; two secondary blocks are exploratory. Interactions use restriction with existing lagged benchmark volatility and amount surprise, not same-day shocks. All blocks, coefficients, SVD rank/condition and delete-one-date sensitivity retained; no best-block adoption.
pairing_rule: Rebuild all seven references and each added model on identical company-dates within its block. Preserve the full 123 by 43 grid with explicit exclusions. Primary and restriction-interaction blocks must have identical eligibility; maturity block may have different issuers and cannot be compared by raw cross-block errors.
